Module io.github.brantunger.unruly.core
Package io.github.brantunger.unruly.api.language

Class ActionResult

java.lang.Object
io.github.brantunger.unruly.api.language.ActionResult
public final class ActionResult extends Object
What an action did: changed the output object itself (done()), or produced properties for the engine to set on it (set(Map)). A language whose expressions compute values without side effects returns properties.

The engine sets the properties in the order of the map, after the action returns, with the engine's OutputWriter. By default that is put on a Map output, and on any other output the public setter whose parameter accepts the value, such as setInterestRate for interestRate, converting it only as Java widens a primitive, when no setter takes it as it is, such as an Integer for a setter taking a long. A property the writer can't set fails the rule with a RuleExecutionException, which listeners receive in onError. In a run of an engine that fires every match, each firing rule's properties are set in turn, so a later rule can overwrite an earlier one's.
